# Trump approval rating still hovering near record lows, new poll shows

Portrait of Fernando Cervantes Jr.

Despite a slight improvement in the polls for President Donald Trump, his approval rating continues to hover near record lows in a new survey released by The Economist/YouGov on Aug. 25.

The poll found that 36% of Americans approved of Trump’s performance, a 1 percentage point improvement from last week’s The Economist/YouGov poll. President Donald Trump’s approval rating has fallen to 33 percent in the latest Economist/YouGov poll, marking his lowest approval in YouGov tracking across both his first and second terms. The survey, conducted August 7–10, 2026, found that 62 percent of Americans disapprove of his job performance, giving Trump a net approval rating of -29, also the lowest he has ever recorded.
